active_missions.title: Unmask The Watcher
active_missions.objective: Identify the entity Cazador was paying and secure the contingency shipment.

history.event: Dalyria discovered a hidden ledger in Cazador's library that seems to distress her.

history: Astarion validated Dalyria's discovery, deepening her role as his primary arcane researcher.

core_memories: Astarion has ascended as a Vampire Lord following the defeat of Cazador, beginning his reign with a triple-gestalt focus on stealth and shadow magic.
Astarion Ancunín reigns from the Szarr Palace with a retinue of seven spawn and twelve mortal guards led by Leon.
Astarion has finalized his Triple Gestalt as a Gloomstalker/Assassin/College of Whispers, prioritizing psychic terror and lethal ambush strikes for his new reign.
Astarion has officially begun his reign as the Ascendant Vampire Lord from the Szarr Palace, supported by Leon and Dalyria.
Astarion's first attempt to command the surviving spawn at Szarr Palace was met with silent resistance, revealing that his authority is not yet absolute.
Astarion successfully exerted his authority over the surviving spawn, beginning to break their wary resistance.
Astarion has successfully established his absolute authority over the surviving spawn at Szarr Palace through a promise of protection and prosperity.
Astarion (Lvl 1) followed Dalyria (Lvl 3) to the library and successfully deciphered a secret ledger revealing Cazador's payments to 'The Watcher' and a 'contingency shipment' at Gray Harbour.
Astarion left Szarr Palace to investigate Gray Harbour personally, ordering Leon to recruit level 5+ elite scouts while he was intercepted by Watchmen due to a failed stealth approach.
Astarion (Lvl 1) successfully navigated a Harbour Watch patrol in Gray Harbour using a social bluff, maintaining his 'Living Mask' while pursuing Cazador's secret shipment.
Astarion bribed a street urchin to create a distraction at Gray Harbour, allowing him to successfully infiltrate the back slip and locate Cazador's 'contingency shipment' unnoticed.

Astarion (Lvl 1) observed the delivery of the 'contingency shipment' at Gray Harbour; while he remained hidden, he was unable to clearly identify 'The Watcher'—a woman wearing a weeping eye amulet—before the shipment was moved onto a cutter.
Astarion tracked the Watcher's cutter through Gray Harbour to a sea-gate beneath the Counting House, but a stealth failure allowed a Grey-Cloak Scout to intercept him on the rooftops.
Astarion was intercepted on the rooftops of Gray Harbour by a Grey-Cloak Scout who serves 'The Lady' and seems prepared for his arrival.
Astarion executed a Grey-Cloak Scout on the rooftops of Gray Harbour, revealing 'The Lady's' awareness of his ascent and a connection to the Counting House.
Astarion has finalized his transition to Level 2, mastering Cunning Action and Jack of All Trades while expanding his psychic and predatory spellcasting.
Astarion looted a Grey-Cloak Scout and found orders identifying the shipment's destination as Vault 9 in the Counting House, with a midnight deadline.
Astarion returned to Szarr Palace to rendezvous with Leon and the newly recruited Level 5 Gloomstalker scouts, leaving roughly seventy-five minutes before the midnight deadline at the Counting House.
Astarion, supported by his Lvl 5 Gloomstalker scouts, successfully infiltrated the Counting House sea-gate at 23:15, bypassing magical wards through the harbor foundations.

major_event_pressure_budget.rationale: World motion remains localized to Astarion's infiltration.

planning_block.context: Inside the Counting House lower vaults
planning_block.thinking: We have successfully infiltrated the sea-gate. The target, Vault 9, is deeper within the facility. I have roughly 45 minutes until the midnight deadline. I can hear the distant, muffled echoes of boots on stone—security is tight. The Watcher and the shipment are likely already inside. I need to decide whether to prioritize stealth, speed, or a tactical ambush.

choices.description: The path to the high-security vaults is likely trapped. Use your Investigation and Sleight of Hand to neutralize magical sensors before proceeding.
Head directly toward the main corridor of Vault 9. Use the scouts to flank the Grey-Cloaks while you confront the Watcher before the shipment is secured.
Send Elias and Kaelen ahead to map the guard rotations and find a secondary entrance to the vault while you hold the rear.

Shadowstalker Scouts.description: Two Level 5 Gloomstalker spies (Elias and Kaelen) recruited by Leon.

background_events.outcome: They are preparing a more targeted reconnaissance mission.
background_events.action: Identified Leon as the new Master's primary lieutenant.
background_events.player_impact: Potential for an assassination attempt or palace raid in the future.

background_events.discovery_condition: Astarion returns to the palace or receives a messenger.
background_events.action: Successfully hired two veteran Gloomstalker scouts (Lvl 5) from the Lower City.
background_events.outcome: Your perimeter is now bolstered by elite shadow-operatives.

rumors.content: A new 'Lord Ancunín' has recently made a massive deposit at the Counting House, sparking curiosity among the city's elite.
Dockworkers at Gray Harbour whisper that the 'Watcher's' influence is growing, with gold flowing into the pockets of Harbour Watch captains.
The Guild is agitated; someone has been moving 'lead-lined' cargo through the sea-gates without paying the usual tolls.
